documentation.content:
The production app logged an email sending failure.

This policy matches three log lines, in the scheduler Job, the web service and the Resque worker pool:

- `[inactivity sweep] mail stopped for this run`: the inactivity sweep stopped sending its deletion notices this run, on an SES outage, throttling, a setup error (paused sending, credentials, configuration set, unverified identity) or repeated rejections (`app/models/concerns/subscription.rb`). The line names the error class and, for a setup error, says it needs an operator.
- `SES delivery failed`: SES refused one message as InvalidParameterValue, which `General.deliver_message` (`app/mailers/concerns/general.rb`) logs and swallows. Email addresses in the error text are scrubbed by `PiiScrubbingFormatter`.
- `[job failed] <Mailer> . deliver_message (<mail type>) <error class>`: a queued mail job (password reset, consent and notification mail) raised, for example SES MessageRejected, throttling or a sending pause (`lib/job_failure_log.rb`, a Resque failure hook). The line carries no address, id or error message. It also fires on mailer code errors (for example a NoMethodError), not only SES problems.

Not covered: an SES error raised inside a non-mailer job (logged as `<Class> . perform_action`), and mail SES accepts and later bounces.

What to check, in order:

1. Open the matched log entry from the incident and read the error class.
2. SES console for us-west-2 (account 239044785114): account status (sending paused or under review), and the reputation dashboard.
3. For a setup error: the Cloud Run secrets AWS_KEY / AWS_SECRET, SES_REGION / AWS_REGION, and SES_CONFIGURATION_SET (`lingolinq-transactional`).

No log text is copied into the notification (no label extractors). Notifications are limited to one an hour; an incident closes itself after 7 days without a new match.

conditions.displayName: An email sending failure was logged

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type=("cloud_run_job" OR "cloud_run_revision" OR "cloud_run_worker_pool") AND (textPayload:"[inactivity sweep] mail stopped" OR textPayload:"SES delivery failed" OR (textPayload:"[job failed] " AND textPayload:"Mailer . deliver_message"))
